$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoTitle: Greenhouse Jobs Scraper - Every Greenhouse Job Board
seoDescription: Search every company on Greenhouse at once: job titles, salary ranges, locations, remote work and posting dates. Live, no login or Greenhouse API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: TODO_DEPLOYED: measure the empty form with every default at 1024 and 2048 MB on the deployed build (seconds, usageTotalUsd, run ids) and keep the cheaper size that finishes well inside 300 s. Engine v0.4.0 on the laptop (2026-11-03, /usr/bin/time -l, MB as Apify counts them): the example input took 113 s and 22.3 s of CPU and peaked at 330 MB footprint (221 MB resident); the empty form with every default took 113 s and 26.9 s of CPU and peaked at 394 MB (314 MB resident), downloading about 24 MB. Apify gives a quarter CPU core at 1 GB and half a core at 2 GB, and the pacer holds a pass to at least 105 s, so 1 GB is the cheaper size while its pass takes less than twice the 2 GB one. 2 GB until then, for the description search: a kubernetes description search peaked at 1.53 GB at the 2 GB setting (the 100 biggest boards 10 at once) and 0.88 GB at 1 GB (3 at once); every job, maxJobs 0, peaked at 669 MB (f-final-all). minMemoryMbytes is 1024 for that.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor: fantastic-jobs/greenhouse-jobs-api, the most used actor made for Greenhouse (156 u30): $0.002 a job on FREE and BRONZE, $0.0012 on SILVER and above, no start fee, one row with the description from its own database. job is 10% under it and job-details 5% under it on FREE and BRONZE. Others: bovi $0.0015 + $0.00005 start (company slugs or preset lists), yugenox $0.002 (live keyword search, Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby), bytepulselabs $0.002 (board links), automation-lab $0.002 + $0.01 start, jobo.world $0.004 (database). No start fee: a search reads every board. On engine v0.4.0 (laptop, 2026-11-03) a pass took 113 s and moved about 24 MB in and 2 MB out, so at FREE and BRONZE rates about $0.013 of compute at 2 GB plus $0.005 of data transfer: about 10% of the $0.18 that 100 rows earn, at the edge of the 10% rule, and under it at 1 GB (TODO_DEPLOYED: usageTotalUsd). Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29. apply is false for the first, private measurement deploy: the orchestrator sets the final prices and apply true after measuring a run on Apify.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, pay, posting date, deadline, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, the department, the company's reference number and pay as numbers with its currency.
